like.chinese: 春天是我最喜欢的季节。

like.english: I like to go fishing with my father.
like.chinese: 我喜欢和父亲一起去钓鱼。

like.english: I like to listen to music, especially jazz.
like.chinese: 我喜欢听音乐，特别是爵士音乐。

like.english: I like to take a walk after meals.
I would like to retract my previous statement.
like.chinese: 我想撤回我之前的陈述。

help.english: Help yourself to anything you'd like to eat.
It's very kind of you to help me.
This product claims to help you lose weight.
help.chinese: 这个产品称它能帮助你减肥。

help.english: You're the only one who can help us.
help.chinese: 你是唯一一个能帮助我们的人。

help.english: Can you help me find a job?
help.chinese: 你能帮我找一个工作吗？

help.english: Can you help me wash these dishes?
help.chinese: 你能帮我洗这些碗盘吗？

help.english: Can't you do something to help me?
help.chinese: 你不能做些事来帮助我吗？

help.english: Could you help me find my dog?
help.chinese: 你能帮我找到我的狗吗？

start.english: We agreed to start early the next morning.
start.chinese: 我们同意了第二天一早开始。

start.english: You had better not start until they arrive.
start.chinese: 你最好不要在他们来之前开始。

start.english: This is a great place to start.
We've got to start thinking about recycling.
start.chinese: 我们必须开始考虑回收。

start.english: When to start is the main problem.
start.chinese: 主要问题是什么时候开始。

start.english: As soon as it gets dark, the fireworks will start.
start.chinese: 天一黑，就会开始放焰火了。

start.english: I don't know where to start.
start.chinese: 我不太知道从哪里开始。

start.english: Shall we start the meeting now?

become.english: Why did you want to become a teacher?
Why do you want to become a nurse?
become.chinese: 你为什么想成为护士呢？

become.english: You should be careful not to become overconfident.
He has decided to become a teacher.
become.chinese: 他已经决定要成为一名教师。

become.english: Her daughter has become a beautiful woman.
become.chinese: 她的女儿已经变成一个漂亮的女人。

become.english: His daughter has become a pretty woman.
become.chinese: 他的女儿已经成为了一个漂亮的女人。

become.english: I would like to become a poet.
My dream is to become a pilot.
become.chinese: 我的梦想是成为一名飞行员。

happen.english: I can't guarantee that that's going to happen.
happen.chinese: 我不能确保这一切会发生。

happen.english: I don't want something like this to happen.
If anything should happen, please let me know.
happen.chinese: 如果发生了什么事，请告诉我。

happen.english: Nobody knows what will happen in the future.
happen.chinese: 人不知道未来可能发生什么事。

happen.english: An earthquake can happen at any time.
Do you happen to know his name?
happen.chinese: 你说不定知道他的名字？

happen.english: I don't want something bad to happen to us.
happen.chinese: 我可不想要坏事发生在我们身上。

happen.english: I had a feeling this might happen.
happen.chinese: 我早就有感觉到这可能会发生。

show.english: Can you show me on the map?
show.chinese: 可以在地图上展示给我看吗？

show.english: Did you show it to your parents?
I have some pictures to show you.
I want to show you something in my office.
show.chinese: 我想给你看看我办公室里的一些东西。

show.english: I wanted to show it to you.
I'm not going to show any fear.
Please show me what to do next.
show.chinese: 请告诉我下一步该做什么。

show.english: Show me how much money you have.

seem.english: You seem like a very smart person.
seem.chinese: 你看起来像一个聪明人。

seem.english: You seem to be a little under the weather.
You seem to be an honest man.
You seem to be waiting for somebody.
I seem to be unlucky today.
I seem to have a fever.
At that moment, time seemed to stand still.
seem.chinese: 那一刻，时间仿佛静止了。

seem.english: It seems that no one knew the truth.

might.english: Since you're here, we might as well begin.
might.chinese: 既然你在这里, 那我们就开始吧。

might.english: Academic fraud is more common than you might think.
might.chinese: 学术造假比你想象的普遍。

might.english: He's afraid that he might be late.
I know someone who might be able to help.
might.chinese: 我知道有个人可能能帮忙。

might.english: I might be a few minutes late.
I might be able to fix that.
I might stay for another few days.
She might know that we are here.
might.chinese: 她或许知道我们在这儿。

hear.english: Did you hear my son play the violin?
hear.chinese: 您听见我儿子拉小提琴了吗？

hear.english: He's already too far away to hear us.
hear.chinese: 他已经离得太远听不到我们了。

hear.english: I could hear birds singing outside my window.
hear.chinese: 我能听见鸟在窗外歌唱。

hear.english: I could hear her sobbing in her bedroom.
hear.chinese: 我能听到她在卧室里抽泣。

hear.english: I don't want to hear about it again.
I don't want to hear any more excuses.
hear.chinese: 我不想再听到其他借口了。

hear.english: I was glad to hear of your success.
hear.chinese: 我很高兴知道你成功了。

hear.english: I was very surprised to hear the news.
hear.chinese: 我听到这个消息很惊讶。

believe.english: Believe it or not, she has three children.
believe.chinese: 她有三个孩子，信不信由你。

believe.english: Do you believe in eternal life after death?
It is hard for me to believe this.
I believe you'll get over it soon.
believe.chinese: 我相信你很快就能复原。

believe.english: I don't know what to believe anymore.
believe.chinese: 我再也不知道该信什么了。

believe.english: They believe in a life after death.
Do you believe there are ghosts?
Do you believe what he said?

play.english: He doesn't have any friends to play with.
I play guitar in a psychedelic rock band.
play.chinese: 我在一支迷幻摇滚乐团里弹吉他。

play.english: I'd like to hear you play the piano.
What's your favorite game to play with friends?
play.chinese: 你最喜欢和朋友玩什么游戏？

play.english: When the cat's away, the mice will play.
play.chinese: 山上无老虎，猴子称大王。

play.english: Can you teach me to play chess?
play.chinese: 您能教我下国际象棋吗？

play.english: Could you teach me how to play the piano?
Do you know how to play mahjong?

turn.english: Did you remember to turn off the oven?
The offer is too good to turn down.
turn.chinese: 此提议好得令人难以拒绝。

turn.english: Do you want me to turn off the lights?
Don't forget to turn the light off.
He forgot to turn off the light.
Hey, can you turn the lights off?
I suggest you turn around and go back home.
Turn right at the first traffic light.
turn.chinese: 在第一个信号灯处右转。

run.english: A dog was run over by a truck.
Sooner or later his luck will run out.
A dog can run faster than a man can.
Generally speaking, men can run faster than women can.
run.chinese: 一般来说, 男人比女人跑得快。

run.english: He is going to run for mayor.
He was run over by a car.
I don't agree with hospitals being run like businesses.
run.chinese: 我不赞成将医院像企业一样经营。

run.english: Run like your life depends on it.

live.english: I live in an apartment in the city.
live.chinese: 我住在城市中的一间公寓里。

live.english: I'll never be able to live this down.
He has no house to live in.
He was too young to live alone.
live.chinese: 他太年轻了无法独自生活。

live.english: I advise you never to live beyond your income.
live.chinese: 我建议你永远不要入不敷出。

live.english: I don't want to live my life in fear.
I'm old enough to live by myself.
live.chinese: 我年纪够大了可以自己一个人住。

live.english: It is impossible to live without water.
live.chinese: 生活没有水是不可能的。

write.english: I still prefer to write letters by hand.
I was just going to write a letter.
She taught me how to write a poem.
Would you please write with a ballpoint pen?
Write your name and address on this envelope.
write.chinese: 把你的姓名和地址写在这个信封上。

write.english: Didn't you write a letter to him?
Give me some paper to write on.
I wish he would write more often.

bring.english: Bring me a glass of tea with lemon.
Hard work and dedication will bring you success.
bring.chinese: 努力和敬业会让你成功。

bring.english: What will it take to bring him down?
bring.chinese: 要怎么才能把他拉下马？

bring.english: You should bring your passport to the bank.
Bring me a sheet of paper, please.
Could you bring my breakfast to room 305?
bring.chinese: 你可以把我的早餐送到305房间吗？

bring.english: Did you bring an umbrella with you?
Did you bring your family with you?

move.english: I suggest we move to a safer location.
move.chinese: 我建议我们去个更安全的地方。

move.english: We rented a truck to move our furniture.
move.chinese: 我们租了辆卡车来运我们的家具。

move.english: Can you move this desk by yourself?
move.chinese: 你能自己搬这张桌子吗?

move.english: Can't you move your stuff to the other room?
move.chinese: 你不能把你的东西搬去另一个房间吗？

move.english: Move the chair nearer to the desk.
move.chinese: 把椅子挪一挪靠近桌子。

move.english: Please move the desk to the left.
Please move your bicycle out of here.
move.chinese: 请将您的自行车移出这里。

move.english: The horse stopped and refused to move.
move.chinese: 马停了下来，而且拒绝移动。

must.english: All essays must be handed in on time.
must.chinese: 所有文章都必须在规定时间内交上来。

must.english: All good things must come to an end.
In doing anything, you must do your best.
must.chinese: 做任何事，你必须要做到最好。

must.english: There must be some way to solve this.
They must have arrived home by this time.
must.chinese: 他们在这个时候一定已经到家了。

must.english: Under no circumstances must you leave the room.
must.chinese: 在任何情况下你都不能离开这个房间。

must.english: You must come back before it gets dark.
You must get rid of that bad habit.
must.chinese: 你必须改掉这个坏习惯。

begin.english: Collect your thoughts before you begin your work.
He gave us the signal to begin.
begin.chinese: 他给了我们开始的信号。

begin.english: I was the first to begin speaking.
begin.chinese: 我是第一个开口说话的人。

begin.english: I don't know where to begin.
begin.chinese: 我不太知道从哪里开始。

begin.english: Peace talks will begin next week.
begin.chinese: 和平会谈将在下周开始。

begin.english: When did it begin to rain?
When did you begin playing golf?
begin.chinese: 你什么时候开始打高尔夫球？

begin.english: Why did you begin without me?
begin.chinese: 为什么你不等等我就开始了？

love.english: I love him, but he loves someone else.
love.chinese: 我爱他，但他有了心上人。

love.english: I love you more than you love me.
I would love to sing with your band.
love.chinese: 我非常乐意和你们乐团一起唱歌。

love.english: I'll always love you, no matter what happens.
love.chinese: 不论发生了什么事，我会永远爱你。

love.english: Does he know that you love him?
I love her and she loves me.
I love the sound of children laughing.
love.chinese: 我喜欢孩子们笑的声音。

love.english: I love you more than anyone else.
love.chinese: 我爱你胜过其他任何一个人。

hold.english: You've got to learn to hold your tongue.
hold.chinese: 你应该学着闭上你的嘴。

hold.english: They will hold a meeting at 2 o'clock this afternoon.
hold.chinese: 他们今天下午2点会举行一个会议。

hold.english: Will you hold this seat for me?
Can you hold on a second?
Please hold the line a moment.
Will you please hold this edge?
The bank was held up a week ago.
hold.chinese: 这家银行一周前被抢劫。

hold.english: The party will be held outdoors, weather permitting.
hold.chinese: 若天气许可的话，派对将会在户外举行。

read.english: How many books do you read per month?
I found it difficult to read the book.
I read the book from cover to cover.
read.chinese: 那本书我从头到尾看完了。

read.english: It is too dark for me to read.
She read an amusing story to the children.
read.chinese: 她给孩子们读了个有趣的故事。

read.english: This book is hard for me to read.
read.chinese: 这本书对我来说很难读。

read.english: While you're young, you should read a lot.
read.chinese: 当你年轻的时候, 你应该多读点儿书。

read.english: Arabic is read from right to left.
read.chinese: 阿拉伯语要从右往左读。

stop.english: Stop getting yourself worked up over little things.
stop.chinese: 不要让自己因为一些小事而烦躁了。

stop.english: You should make an effort to stop smoking.
I couldn't get him to stop smoking.
I tried to stop that from happening.
I've got to stop eating such sweet ice cream.
stop.chinese: 我必须停止吃那么甜的冰激凌。

stop.english: He advised her to stop drinking.
I wish it would stop raining.
I wish they would stop fighting.
stop.chinese: 我希望他们会停止战斗。

pay.english: Each member has to pay 10,000 yen a month.
pay.chinese: 每位会员每月需支付一万日元。

pay.english: How are we going to pay for that?
You need to pay extra for the batteries.
You should pay more attention to his warnings.
pay.chinese: 你应该多注意他的警告。

pay.english: He wants to pay off his loan.
I can't afford to pay so much.
I'd like to pay by credit card.
I'd like to pay the check, please.

provide.english: I will provide you all the necessary information.
provide.chinese: 我会把所有有用的信息提供给您的。

provide.english: The school will provide tents for us.
provide.chinese: 学校会提供帐篷给我们。

provide.english: He has a wife and two young children to provide for.
provide.chinese: 他有一个妻子和两个孩子要养活。

lose.english: I know what it's like to lose someone.
lose.chinese: 我知道这看起来像是失去了某人。

lose.english: This product claims to help you lose weight.
lose.chinese: 这个产品称它能帮助你减肥。

lose.english: He is beginning to lose his hair.
I don't want to lose you again.
I just don't want to lose you.
One who has everything can lose everything.
lose.chinese: 拥有一切的人可能会失去一切。

lose.english: I don't want to lose you.
She really wants to lose weight.

understand.english: English is too difficult for me to understand.
understand.chinese: 英语对我来说太难理解了。

understand.english: People should understand that the world is changing.
Few students could understand what he said.
understand.chinese: 很少有学生能了解他说的话。

understand.english: He can't seem to understand that poem.
understand.chinese: 他似乎无法理解那首诗。

understand.english: He is old enough to understand it.
understand.chinese: 他已经到了能了解它的年纪。

understand.english: I can understand what she is saying.
I can understand you to some extent.
understand.chinese: 在某种程度上我能了解你。

understand.english: I think we're just beginning to understand the problem.
understand.chinese: 我认为我们刚开始了解这个问题。

wait.english: I don't think we can wait any longer.
wait.chinese: 我认为我们不能再等了。

wait.english: I will wait here until he comes back.
wait.chinese: 我会等在这儿直到他回来。

wait.english: Please wait until the end of this month.
Would you please wait for a few minutes?
You don't have to wait until the end.
Five years is too long to wait.
wait.chinese: 五年太漫长而无法等待。

wait.english: How long will we have to wait?
I asked her to wait a minute.

meet.english: It's rare to meet nice people like you.
meet.chinese: 很少能见到像你那么好的人。

meet.english: Thank you for agreeing to meet with us.
You'll find it difficult to meet her requirements.
Can we meet tomorrow morning at nine?
meet.chinese: 在明天早上九点见可以吗？

meet.english: I don't have time to meet up with you.
I had hoped to meet you there.
meet.chinese: 我曾希望在那里遇见你。

meet.english: I want to meet your older sister.
I want you to meet my parents.
meet.chinese: 我想让你见见我的父母。

thank.english: I thank you very much for your kindness.
Thank you for agreeing to meet with us.
Thank you for always taking care of me.
thank.chinese: 谢谢你一直以来对我的照顾。

thank.english: Thank you for drawing a bird for me.
Thank you for inviting me to the party.
thank.chinese: 感谢你请我来参加派对。

thank.english: I thank you from the bottom of my heart.
I thank you with all my heart.
Thank you for baking this delicious cake.

change.english: I have to change into my work clothes.
There was a sudden change in her tone.
We're going to have to change our plans.
change.chinese: 我们快要到必须改变我们计划的时候了。

change.english: Do you have change for a dollar?
change.chinese: 你有零钱换一元美金吗？

change.english: I don't think you need to change.
I think we should change the topic.
change.chinese: 我认为我们该换个题目。

change.english: I'd like to change yen to dollars.
She went into her room to change her dress.
change.chinese: 她进了她的房间换裙子。

watch.english: Did you watch the soccer game on television?
watch.chinese: 你在电视上看足球赛了吗？

watch.english: He often goes with her to watch movies.
watch.chinese: 他常和她一起去看电影。

watch.english: Watch him and do the same thing.
watch.chinese: 看着他并且跟他做同样的事情。

watch.english: Watch him and do what he does.
Watch out for cars when you cross the street.
watch.chinese: 当你过马路的时候要当心汽车。

watch.english: What kind of movie do you want to watch?
watch.chinese: 你想看哪种类型的电影？

watch.english: Do you like to watch movies?
He likes to watch baseball games on TV.
watch.chinese: 他喜欢看电视上的棒球比赛。

sit.english: All you have to do is sit here.
sit.chinese: 你要做的只是坐在这儿。

sit.english: This chair is really comfortable to sit on.
I think you're going to want to sit down.
I'm looking for a place to sit.
Please sit on the sofa and relax.
Sit down and rest for a while.
Why don't you sit down and relax?
sit.chinese: 你为什么不坐下来放松一下。

sit.english: Everybody wants to sit beside her.

create.english: God created the heaven and the earth.
I created an archive of my emails.
create.chinese: 我给自己的邮件做了一份档案。

create.english: According to the Bible, God created the world in six days.
create.chinese: 根据圣经记载，上帝用6天创造了世界。

learn.english: I've always wanted to learn how to swim.
learn.chinese: 我一直想学习如何游泳。

learn.english: It's very easy to learn how to swim.
What's the best way to learn a language?
learn.chinese: 学习一门语言最好的方法是什么？

learn.english: Why do you want to learn that language?
learn.chinese: 你为什么想学习那门语言？

learn.english: You've got to learn to hold your tongue.
learn.chinese: 你应该学着闭上你的嘴。

learn.english: I want to learn how to play the guitar.
I want to learn how to swim.
I've got a lot more to learn.

kill.english: I need some medicine to kill the pain.
I thought she was going to kill me.
Why do you want to kill me?
I didn't mean to kill him.
I was trying to kill time.
They're plotting to kill the king.
kill.chinese: 他们正密谋要杀害国王。

kill.english: This bomb can kill many people.
kill.chinese: 这个炸弹可以炸死很多人。

include.english: The price does not include the box.
include.chinese: 这个价格不包含这个箱子。

include.english: He is included among my friends.

stand.english: At that moment, time seemed to stand still.
stand.chinese: 那一刻，时间仿佛静止了。

stand.english: I will stand by you whatever happens.
stand.chinese: 不论发生什么事，我都会在你身边。

stand.english: We promised to stand by him in case of trouble.
stand.chinese: 我们承诺万一他有麻烦的时候支持他。

stand.english: He was standing at the street corner.
She stood in front of the mirror.
The house stood out because of its unusual shape.
stand.chinese: 那房子因为其少有的形状被突显出来。

follow.english: I will follow you wherever you go.
follow.chinese: 无论你去哪里我都会跟着你。

follow.english: It was sensible of you to follow her advice.
follow.chinese: 你听从她的忠告是明智的。

follow.english: It's important to follow a strict diet.
follow.chinese: 重要的是要遵循严格的饮食控制。

follow.english: He failed to follow our advice.
follow.chinese: 他没有遵循我们的忠告。

follow.english: Why didn't you follow my advice?
follow.chinese: 你为什么不听我的忠告？

follow.english: You have to follow the rules.
You should follow the doctor's advice.
follow.chinese: 你应该遵照医生的忠告。

follow.english: You should follow your teacher's advice.
follow.chinese: 您应遵循你老师的建议。

remember.english: Did you remember to turn off the oven?
Do you remember what happened here last year?
remember.chinese: 你记得这里去年发生了什么事吗？

remember.english: I remember my mother teaching me the alphabet.
remember.chinese: 我记得我母亲教我认字。

remember.english: I remember returning the book to the library.
remember.chinese: 我记得我把书还到图书馆了。

remember.english: I remember the way you used to dance.
remember.chinese: 我记得你以前跳舞的方式。

remember.english: Do you remember where we first met?
remember.chinese: 你还记得我们第一次见面是在哪里吗？

remember.english: Remember to mail this letter tomorrow morning.
remember.chinese: 明天早上记得去寄这封信。

remember.english: Did you remember that you were supposed to buy candles?
remember.chinese: 你记得自己该买蜡烛吗？

speak.english: He boasts that he can speak six languages.
speak.chinese: 他显摆自己能说6种语言。

speak.english: How dare you speak to me like that!

die.chinese: 如果你想活得久一点就戒烟。

die.chinese: 不管怎样，我们所有人都将死。

die.chinese: 恐龙在很久以前灭绝了。

die.chinese: 他死前累积了庞大的财富。

walk.english: I am too tired to walk any more.

walk.chinese: 我每天早上到公园里遛狗。

walk.chinese: 他们的小婴孩已经会走路了。

walk.chinese: 走快一点，不然你会错过火车。

grow.english: I grow tomatoes and onions in my garden.
grow.chinese: 我在花园种了番茄和洋葱。

grow.chinese: 他们在他们的温室里种植草莓。

open.chinese: 我认为你应该在这里开个账户。

consider.chinese: 我把你视为我最要好的朋友之一。

consider.chinese: 人们认为，他完全能胜任这个工作。

hope.english: I hope that you will get well soon.

hope.chinese: 我希望我们有时间还可以见面。

hope.chinese: 我希望没人看见我跳舞。

expect.chinese: 我希望你更加努力地工作。

pull.english: The car pulled up in front of the bank.
He is just pulling your leg.

raise.english: The landlord says he wants to raise the rent.
You don't have to raise your voice.
He would not raise my salary.
If you have a question, please raise your right hand.
raise.chinese: 如果有问题，请举起你的右手。

raise.english: He was raised in an artistic family.

wear.english: I have no idea what to wear.
I want you to wear this.
In the summer I wear short-sleeved shirts.
Wear whatever you want to wear.
What size shoes do you wear?
You need to wear a helmet.
wear.chinese: 你需要戴安全帽。你需要戴头盔。

wear.english: I noticed she was wearing a new hat.
wear.chinese: 我注意到她当时戴了顶新帽子。

wear.english: I noticed that she was wearing new glasses.
wear.chinese: 我注意到她戴着新眼镜。

return.english: You should return home before it gets dark.
return.chinese: 你应该在天黑之前回家。

return.english: I have no home to return to.
I must return home within a week.
They say that he will never return.
return.chinese: 他们说他再也不会回来了。

return.english: You must return the book to him.
I have to return this book to the library today.
return.chinese: 我今天得把这本书还给图书馆。

return.english: Please return the book by tomorrow.
You should return what you borrow.

choose.english: Choose the color you like the best.
I had to choose between the two.
You may choose any book you like.
choose.chinese: 你可以选择任何你喜欢的书。

choose.english: Choose any one from among these.
I don't know who to choose.
You may choose any of them.
choose.chinese: 你可以选择他们之中的任何一个。

choose.english: You may choose what you like.
You may choose whichever you want.
choose.chinese: 你可以选择任何你想要的。

cause.english: I don't want to cause any more trouble.
I'm sorry to cause you all this trouble.
cause.chinese: 我很抱歉给你惹来所有的这些麻烦。

cause.english: We don't want to cause you any trouble.
Slight inattention can cause a great disaster.
Ultraviolet rays can cause skin cancer.
His son's criminal activities caused him great pain.
cause.chinese: 他儿子的犯罪行为给他带来了很大的痛苦。

cause.english: Some diseases are caused by a defective gene.
cause.chinese: 一些疾病的产生原因是基因缺陷。

cause.english: A spark caused the gunpowder to explode.

join.english: Which group do you want to join?
I'd like to join your group.
I'm going to join a demonstration.
join.chinese: 我要参加一个示威游行。

join.english: Why don't you join our party?
join.chinese: 你为什么不参加我们的派对？

join.english: Won't you join us for dinner?
join.chinese: 你不来跟我们一起吃晚饭吗？

join.english: There's no membership fee for joining.
He joined the Army during the war.

develop.english: It takes time to develop political awareness.
develop.chinese: 培养政治意识要花费时间。

develop.english: Our country must develop its natural resources.
develop.chinese: 我们国家必须开发自然资源。

develop.english: The storm developed into a typhoon.
develop.chinese: 暴风雨发展成了一个台风。
我正在开发一个安卓应用。

share.english: I share a bedroom with my sister.
share.chinese: 我跟我姐姐共用同一间卧房。

share.english: Pigs share certain characteristics with human beings.
share.chinese: 猪与人类的一些特性相同。

share.english: We agreed to share the housework.

share.chinese: 不要告诉任何人这件事。

share.english: May I share this table with you?
share.chinese: 我可以跟你共用这张桌子吗?

share.english: You shouldn't share too much private information on the social networks.
share.chinese: 你不应该在社交网络上分享过多私人信息。

realize.english: Life begins when we realize who we really are.
realize.chinese: 当我们明白真正的自己时，生活开始了。

realize.english: Only then did he realize he had been deceived.
realize.chinese: 直到那时，他才意识到他已经上当受骗。

realize.english: Do you realize what this means?
realize.chinese: 你明白这是什么意思了吗？

realize.english: He realized his dream of becoming an artist.
realize.chinese: 他实现了当兿术家的梦想。

realize.english: She may realize later what I meant.
realize.chinese: 她可能以后会明白我的意思。

describe.chinese: 详细叙述一下这起事故吧。

describe.english: He described the incident in detail.
describe.chinese: 他详细地描述了事故状况。

describe.english: She described him as a detective.
Can you describe to me the difference between black tea and green tea?
describe.chinese: 你能告诉我红茶和绿茶的区别吗？

increase.english: There was a steady increase in population.
If you feed your dog properly, you can increase his lifespan.
increase.chinese: 合理地喂狗可以延长宠物寿命。

increase.english: Sleep deprivation increases risk of heart attacks.
increase.chinese: 睡眠不足增加心脏病发作的危险。

increase.english: Alcohol consumption is increasing every year.
increase.chinese: 酒的消费每年都在上升。

increase.english: The number of people suffering from heart disease has increased.
increase.chinese: 遭受心脏病困扰的人数增加了。

increase.english: The number of people who go abroad has been increasing.
increase.chinese: 出国的人数一直在增加。

increase.english: I hear that the number of the unemployed has been increasing recently.
increase.chinese: 听说最近失业者人数正在增加

protect.english: We should tell children how to protect themselves.
protect.chinese: 我们应该告诉孩子怎么保护自己。

protect.english: You're the only one who can protect them.
He did all he could to protect his son.
I was just trying to protect you.

compare.english: Compare your answers with the teacher's.
compare.chinese: 把你的答案和老师的比较一下。

compare.english: Compared to our house, yours is a mansion.
compare.chinese: 跟我们的房子比，你的就是个豪宅。

compare.english: Compared with her sister, she isn't very punctual.
compare.chinese: 与她的妹妹相比，她不是很准时。

compare.english: He compared his car to the new model.
compare.chinese: 他拿他的车和新款车作比较。

compare.english: Compared to yours, my car is small.
compare.chinese: 和你的车比起来，我的车很小。

compare.english: He compared the copy with the original.
compare.chinese: 他比较了复印稿和原件。

compare.english: Reading a book can be compared to a journey.
compare.chinese: 阅读一本书可以比作一次旅行。

reduce.english: He wanted to reduce the tax on imports.
reduce.chinese: 他想要减少进口品的税。

reduce.english: I have to reduce my expenses this month.
Can you reduce the price a bit?
I think we should reduce the price.
reduce.chinese: 我觉得我们得调低价格。

reduce.english: Mass production reduced the price of many goods.
reduce.chinese: 大量生产降低许多商品的价格。
我们必须降低能源需求。

reduce.english: The fire reduced the house to ashes.
reduce.chinese: 房子被大火烧成了灰烬。

reduce.english: Karaoke is good for reducing stress.

accept.english: I had no choice but to accept the offer.
accept.chinese: 除了接受报价，我别无选择。

accept.english: It was foolish of you to accept his offer.
accept.chinese: 你真笨去接受他的提议。

accept.english: He did not accept my apologies.
He did not accept their invitation.
accept.chinese: 他没有接受他们的邀请。

accept.english: I'm prepared to accept the consequences.
She had to accept her fate.
She refused to accept the money.
We accept all major credit cards.
accept.chinese: 我们接受所有主要的信用卡。

prepare.english: You don't need to prepare a formal speech.
prepare.chinese: 您没必要准备一个正式的演讲。

prepare.english: You should prepare for the worst.
Mom is preparing a meal in the kitchen.

prepare.chinese: 我的姊妹将会准备早餐。

prepare.english: She prepares wholesome meals for her family.
prepare.chinese: 她为她的家人准备健康餐。

prepare.english: Every morning she helps her mother to prepare breakfast in the kitchen.
prepare.chinese: 她每天早上都帮母亲在厨房准备早餐。

avoid.english: I avoid discussing personal subjects with my boss.
avoid.chinese: 我避免跟老板讨论个人话题。

avoid.english: Try to avoid making any more trouble.
avoid.chinese: 尽量避免制造任何更多的麻烦。

avoid.english: We must avoid war at all cost.
avoid.chinese: 我们应该不惜代价避免战争。

avoid.english: We got up at dawn to avoid a traffic jam.
avoid.chinese: 我们黎明时起床以避开交通堵塞。

avoid.english: Sometimes the Allies could not avoid battle.
avoid.chinese: 有时候盟军无法避免战争。

avoid.english: We should try to avoid imposing our own beliefs on others.
avoid.chinese: 我们应该尽量避免把我们自己的信念强加在别人身上。

avoid.english: War must be avoided at all costs.
avoid.chinese: 战争必须不惜一切代价地去避免。

notice.english: I didn't notice the light turn red.
notice.chinese: 我没有注意到灯变红色了。

notice.english: He's bound to notice your mistake.
notice.chinese: 他必定会觉察到你的错误。

notice.english: I noticed she was wearing a new hat.
notice.chinese: 我注意到她当时戴了顶新帽子。

notice.english: I noticed that she was wearing new glasses.
notice.chinese: 我注意到她戴着新眼镜。
你注意到奇怪的地方了吗？

notice.english: No one noticed her absence until the meeting ended.
notice.chinese: 直到会议结束之前都没人注意到她不在。

notice.english: The thief got in without being noticed.
notice.chinese: 小偷在没有被发现的情况下进去了。

affect.english: The bad weather affected his health.
affect.chinese: 恶劣的天气对他的健康带来了影响。

affect.english: The strike affected the nation's economy.

affect.chinese: 那天有数百万人受影响。

manage.english: You should be able to manage it.
I managed to repair my car by myself.
manage.chinese: 我自己搞定，修好了我的车。

manage.english: He managed to get home before dark.
He managed to get there in time.
manage.chinese: 他设法及时到达那里了。

manage.english: He managed to make both ends meet.
I managed to catch the last train.
manage.chinese: 我设法赶上了最后一班火车。

manage.english: I managed to get there in time.
I managed to make him understand it.

improve.english: Our situation should improve in the near future.
improve.chinese: 我们近期内的情况应该会好转。

improve.english: There are many ways to improve one's life.
improve.chinese: 有很多的方法可以改善人的一生。

improve.english: I made efforts to improve my grades.
improve.chinese: 我努力地改善我的成绩。

improve.english: We need to improve our customer service.
improve.chinese: 我们需要改进我们的客服业务。

improve.english: I would like to improve my English pronunciation.
improve.chinese: 我想改善我的英语发音。

improve.english: I'd like to find a way to improve my memory.
improve.chinese: 我想找一种提升记忆力的方法。

improve.english: Like a good wine, he improves with age.
improve.chinese: 就像上好的红酒一样，他随着年龄的增长变得越来越好。

improve.english: The situation is improving, so cheer up!
improve.chinese: 情况正在改善，所以振作起来！

discover.english: Call me if you discover anything.
discover.chinese: 如果你发现什么，请打给我。

discover.english: The explorers discovered a skeleton in the cave.
discover.chinese: 探险家们在洞穴里发现了骸骨。

discover.english: She discovered that she had run out of salt.
Doctors have discovered some startling facts.
discover.chinese: 医生发现了一些令人吃惊的事实。

discover.english: He was discovered unconscious on the floor of the kitchen.
discover.chinese: 他被人发现倒在厨房的地板上，不省人事。

discover.english: America was discovered by Columbus in 1492.
discover.chinese: 美国在1492年被哥伦布发现。

discover.english: His lie got him into trouble when his boss discovered the truth.
discover.chinese: 当他老板发现真相的时候，谎言给他带来了麻烦。

handle.english: I don't know how to handle children.
handle.chinese: 我不知道如何对待孩子。

handle.english: You need to let me handle this.
This car is easy to handle.
Here is a pan without handles.

achieve.english: You'll never achieve anything if you don't study harder.
achieve.chinese: 如果你不更加努力地学习, 你将永远不会有所成就。

achieve.english: She achieved great success in her business.
achieve.chinese: 她在她的事业上取得了巨大成功。

achieve.english: I have made up my mind to achieve my goals in three years.
achieve.chinese: 我下定决心要在三年之内达成目标。
没有什么是不劳而获的。

express.english: I don't know how to express my thanks.
express.chinese: 我不知道如何表达我的谢意。

express.english: No words can express her deep sorrow.
Express yourself as clearly as possible.
express.chinese: 尽可能明确地表达你自己。

express.english: She was at a loss for words to express her feeling.
express.chinese: 她已经无法用语言表达她的感觉了。

express.english: She expressed her feelings for nature in a poem.
express.chinese: 她通过一首诗表达了她对大自然的感受。

express.english: The poet expressed his burning passion for the woman he loved.
express.chinese: 诗人对他爱的女人表达了他火热的激情。

encourage.english: We are encouraged to use our imagination.
encourage.chinese: 我们被鼓励使用想象力。

depend.english: I guess it depends on the weather.
Whether you succeed or not depends on your own efforts.
depend.chinese: 你成功与否取决于你自身的努力。

depend.english: The value of the coins depended on the weight of the metal used.
depend.chinese: 钱币的价值取决于所使用的金属的重量。

prefer.english: I prefer being poor to being rich.
prefer.chinese: 我更愿意贫穷而不是富裕。

prefer.english: Which do you prefer, dogs or cats?
prefer.chinese: 狗和猫你更喜欢哪一个？

prefer.english: Which do you prefer, rice or bread?
prefer.chinese: 你比较喜欢哪一个，米饭还是面包？

prefer.english: Which do you prefer, spring or autumn?
prefer.chinese: 春天和秋天，你更喜欢哪个？

prefer.english: Which do you prefer, tea or coffee?
prefer.chinese: 你比较喜欢哪一个，茶还是咖啡?

prefer.english: I prefer hardwood floors to carpet.
prefer.chinese: 我喜欢硬木地板胜过地毯。

prefer.english: I prefer red wine to white.
prefer.chinese: 我喜欢红葡萄酒胜过白葡萄酒。

prefer.english: I prefer to travel by air.

solve.english: None of the teachers could solve the problem.
solve.chinese: 所有的老师都无法解决这个问题。

solve.english: There must be some way to solve this.
He was able to solve the problem.
I can solve the problem by myself.
solve.chinese: 我可以自己解决这个问题。

solve.english: I know how to solve the problem.
solve.chinese: 我知道怎么解决这个问题。

solve.english: I understand how to solve the problem.
Tell me how to solve the problem.
solve.chinese: 告诉我如何解决这个问题。

solve.english: We have our own problems to solve.
solve.chinese: 我们有自己的问题要解决。
